meaning: AFP GoedelGod.thy, Monotheism, as a secondary consequence: from A1b and excluded middle alone, any two God-like beings at a world are Leibniz-equal there (DEF-LEIBNIZ-EQUALITY-SCOTT), through Flawlessness. Full property quantification makes this identity of individuals: at most one God-like individual per world. This argument does not establish existence; combined with the separate C2 result it establishes exactly one per world, without asserting the same individual across worlds. Formal consequence inside the Lean embedding of QML KB (DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY) only: it shows nothing about what Gödel or Scott intended, nor that the axioms are true.
